author: Gan Bahadur Khadka
review_text: eSewa – Nepal’s No.1 Digital Wallet eSewa is a game-changer for digital payments in Nepal. From mobile top-ups and utility bill payments to bank transfers and QR code payments everything is just a few taps away. The user interface is clean and simple, making it easy even for first-time users. What I love most is the ability to send and receive money instantly, even to bank accounts. Booking tickets, paying school fees, and shopping online is super convenient too. It’s fast, reliable, and secure.
